audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Lucian rows 1 and 7 and Skill everywhere between. The already-audited mirror (lucian__volibear) flipped rows 2-6 to Lucian and the 2+ items row to Volibear on both layers, and the old row 7 also contradicted its own phases[6].why, which says Volibear is a drain-tank Lucian cannot burst.
audit.why: Lucian holds every stage where he can space: Piercing Light at 500, Ardent Blaze at 900, and a dash whose cooldown his own attacks refund. Volibear's stage is two items, when he survives the kite long enough to land one stun.
audit.corrected: Skill, Lucian, Lucian, Lucian, Lucian, Lucian, Volibear on both layers with matching ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as the moment the lane flips to Volibear.
audit.why: Stormbringer is a 550-range leap on 160s at rank 1 that grants bonus health and disables towers; The Culling reaches 1400. The ultimate does not out-range him, it only punishes a spent dash.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and spikes[1] now carry both ranges and gate the leap on Relentless Pursuit being genuinely down.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the reader to track Relentless Pursuit as a fixed cooldown. Riot's own text says Lightslinger attacks reduce it — so the timer is not what decides the window. Sky Splitter was also implied to be part of the engage rather than a slow with a self-shield only inside the blast.
audit.why: A Volibear who counts to 16 and steps up will meet a dash that came back early off two double-shots. Counting his attacks is the correct read.
audit.corrected: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 / 445 range but refunded by Lightslinger attacks; Sky Splitter slows and self-shields; the stun is Thundering Smash and Frenzied Maul heals only on the second cast into the same mark.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers and no sequence.
audit.why: The punish window is the gap after a spent dash that his shots have not yet refunded.
audit.corrected: Written with the rank-1 cooldown, the range, and the refund mechanic.

edits.before: He kites you out — survive, then stun-engage on the Relentless Pursuit cooldown and out-bite the brawl. Volibear wins by trading around Lucian's Relentless Pursuit and cashing the pattern: stun-engage on the Relentless Pursuit cooldown and out-bite the brawl.
edits.after: He kites you out — Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1, but Lightslinger attacks refund it, so count his shots rather than the timer. Survive to two items, then stun with Thundering Smash and cash the second Frenzied Maul on the same mark for the heal.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Relentless Pursuit (E): 16s at rank 1, 445 range — but every Lightslinger attack shortens it, so count his shots, not the timer.

edits.before: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Lightslinger attacks refund it — count his shots, not the sixteen seconds.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The second Frenzied Maul on a marked target is your heal — no mark, no sustain.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Lucian has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, but Piercing Light (500 range) and a Lightslinger double-shot beat your walk-up — hold the stun for his dash.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Lucian under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter slows and shields you inside the blast, but it is not a stun — Relentless Pursuit (16s at rank 1) still steps out of the bite.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Lucian down every time Relentless Pursuit is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard, but Lightslinger attacks cut Relentless Pursuit's cooldown — the dash is back sooner than you counted.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Lucian under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables his tower on landing, but at 550 range it lands inside The Culling — leap only when Relentless Pursuit is spent.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Lucian to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky heals on the first hit, but his item spike out-paces it — take the wave and pick him off with your jungler.

edits.before: Level 6 flips to you: R Stormbringer is the gap-close and slow to catch him.
edits.after: Level 6 stays his: The Culling (1400 range) out-ranges your 550 leap.

edits.before: First item is yours as W's on-hit and your combo fold his squishy frame.
edits.after: First item is his — Lightslinger double-shots out-pace your bites.

edits.before: Your R Stormbringer gives you the gap-close and slow he's been dodging all lane; leap on when his E is down and Q-W-E-R chunks him before he can Culling from range.
edits.after: Stormbringer is a 550-range leap on 160s while The Culling reaches 1400 — level 6 is still his, so leap only after Relentless Pursuit is spent and his shots have not refunded it.

edits.before: With your first item and W Frenzied Maul's on-hit, once you stick to Lucian his squishy frame folds; his damage doesn't out-trade your health and sustain in a committed all-in.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul's on-hit and second-bite heal are real, but sticking is the problem — his item spike lands first, so trade only when his dash is gone and finish with Sky Splitter's slow.

notes: The packet's suspect name "Frenzied Maul's" is a FALSE POSITIVE (possessive form of the real ability). CHART READING FLAGGED FOR QA: the mirror recorded 'Rows 2-6 flipped to Lucian and the 2+ items row flipped to Volibear'. Read as 1-indexed rows that is Level 2 through First item to Lucian and 2+ items to Volibear, which is what I wrote; read as 0-indexed array indices it would be self-contradictory (index 6 is the 2+ items row). It also disagrees with the packet chart, which gives Volibear Level 6 and First item. I followed the mirror per the do-not-fight-the-mirror rule — if the mirror actually means the packet shape, rows 4 and 5 need flipping back on both layers together. Volibear's E carries a 'projectile' derived flag that contradicts Riot's own text; no Wind Wall claim written.
